title: Two Sum
description: Find two different array elements whose values add up to a target.
constraints: The input must contain at least two numbers.
A valid pair is guaranteed to exist.

examples.explanation: The values at indices 0 and 1 add up to 9.

title: Binary Search
description: Find the index of a target value in a sorted array.
constraints: The input array is sorted in ascending order.

examples.explanation: The target value is located at index 3.

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: Calculate the maximum profit from one purchase followed by one sale.
constraints: The sale must occur after the purchase.

examples.explanation: Buying at 1 and selling later at 8 gives a profit of 7.

title: Maximum Subarray
description: Find the largest sum obtainable from a non-empty contiguous section of an array.
constraints: The array contains at least one number.

title: Valid Parentheses
description: Determine whether brackets are correctly matched and properly nested.
constraints: The input contains only bracket characters.

examples.explanation: Each opening bracket has a matching closing bracket in the correct order.

title: Contains Duplicate
description: Determine whether any value appears at least twice in an array.
constraints: Each value is a safe integer.

title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array
description: Remove duplicate values in-place from a sorted array and return the number of unique values.
constraints: Each value is a safe integer.
nums is sorted in non-decreasing order.

examples.explanation: The first two positions contain 1 and 2.

title: Move Zeroes
description: Move all zeros to the end of the array while preserving the relative order of non-zero values.
constraints: Each value is a safe integer.

examples.explanation: Non-zero values stay in their original order.
